mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as capital costs decline.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 220.0 signals accelerating inflation, triggering Fed rate hikes that reduce equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 220.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) above 0.5% monthly indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint GDPC1/HOUST growth condition fails to produce positive 60-day returns in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, UNRATE below 4.0% combined with PAYEMS growth exceeding 0.5% monthly signals labor market overheating, triggering inflation fears and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances during late-cycle expansion with UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS growth > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) above 500.0 units indicate strong residential construction demand, correlating with positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 500.0.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 90.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 90.0.

mechanism_narrative: Labor market tightness (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE < 4.0%) fuels wage inflation, prompting Fed rate hikes that reduce equity multiples and cause negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint PAYEMS/UNRATE condition fails to produce negative 60-day returns in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 220.0) signal aggressive inflation control, reducing risk appetite and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles with FEDFUNDS > 0.5 and CPIAUCSL > 220.0.
